mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park tonight. The ISS is passing overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will drop to 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has updated its list of polling locations to include two new spots. Residents are encouraged to visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their specific polling place before heading out, as your assigned location may have changed. Polls remain open from 7 AM until 8 PM on election days.

There is plenty to do in Verona today. You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab some dinner at the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher event at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or join a trivia night at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly report, officers investigated a motor vehicle crash on October 7 involving a juvenile on an electric motorcycle who attempted to pass a vehicle on Basswood Avenue. The juvenile sustained minor injuries in the collision.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so you still have time to head out and grab a scoop.
